{{Quote|Thankfully, Jedi, it is not often that we ''Nothoiins'' find our home overrun by droids, but we certainly know how to celebrate the day of its safe ''return''.|[[Troov]]|<ref name="The Runaway Ride" />}}
The '''Goldskin Parade''' was a parade held in order to celebrate [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiin's]] [[Liberation of Nothoiin|liberation]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] occupation. During this parade, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces also tested the experimental [[Separatist Heavy Speeder]] that was captured during the Separatist's withdrawal from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
